title: Task claim and group authorization behavior violates integration expectations
notes: Cluster D from the final integration run: TC-ISS-102-02/04/05/08 and TC-IDN-02-06/07 fail around concurrent claim winner selection, NotPending, completion by the claimed user, authorization, and group membership behavior. Evidence: _integration_final.log lines 8595-8686 and 16875-23074.
root_cause: TBD. Initial hypothesis: task state-transition predicates and group-membership authorization are inconsistent between claim and completion paths, with concurrency exposing non-atomic winner/state checks.
candidate_resolution: Define one transactional claim/complete state machine, enforce atomic pending-to-claimed updates, and centralize user/group authorization checks against the same membership source used by both operations.
